name: excalimate
description: Excalimate — Create keyframe animations from Excalidraw designs, with an MCP server for AI-driven animation

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @excalimate/project-schema && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/animation-core && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/player-runtime && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/export-runtime && npm run templates:validate:built && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.benchmark:animation: npm run build --workspace @excalimate/project-schema && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/animation-core && npm run benchmark --workspace @excalimate/animation-core
scripts.benchmark:scene-diff: npm run build --workspace @excalimate/project-schema && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/animation-core && npm run benchmark:scene-diff --workspace @excalimate/animation-core
scripts.benchmark:player: npm run build && npm run benchmark --workspace @excalimate/player-runtime && npm run check:player-bundle
scripts.benchmark:export: npm run build --workspace @excalimate/project-schema && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/animation-core && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/player-runtime && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/export-runtime && npm run benchmark --workspace @excalimate/export-runtime
scripts.templates:generate: npm run build --workspace @excalimate/project-schema && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/animation-core && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/player-runtime && node scripts/generate-templates.mjs
scripts.templates:validate: npm run build --workspace @excalimate/project-schema && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/animation-core && npm run build --workspace @excalimate/player-runtime && npm run templates:validate:built
